messages:
maria-ops: Heads up — after last night's BMC batch (v1.3.9) ~40 nodes in rack r3 failed to PXE boot. Serial consoles drop to UEFI emergency shell. Suspect a combo of MTU mismatch on OOB VLAN + unexpected secure-boot toggles from the FW image. Anyone else seeing this?
opsbot: deploy-bmc v1.3.9 applied to rack r3 at 1748649600 by deploy-bot. Rolling windows: 02:00-03:30 UTC.
samir-eng: I'm seeing provisioning controller timeouts for those node IDs. k8s node-provisioner logs show long TFTP handshakes then ECONNRESET.
jess-sre: console excerpt for node r3-14: ```UEFI Secure Boot : Enabled
Loading PXE: Network Timeout
UEFI Shell> fs0:\EFI\BOOT\bootx64.efi : not found```
samir-eng: that console output matches a device that is failing to accept our PK for signed PXE boot. If secure-boot got toggled on, they'd reject unsigned PXE images.
tarun-plat: N++ — also observed L3 path with fragmented ARP/ND leading to a blackhole during provisioning window. Switch reported OOB mtu 1452 on eth0 for that subnet, but hosts expect 1500. Saw a burst of ICMP fragmentation before the PXE failures.
maria-ops: can you paste the link to the switch config? Any chance a VLAN change coincided with the BMC rollout?
tarun-plat: looks like a trunk reconfig (infra change) in the same window. Config diff: ```- ip link set dev br-oob mtu 1500
+ ip link set dev br-oob mtu 1452```
jess-sre: that would fragment the DHCP/TFTP packets. PXE+SecureBoot = tiny signed blobs that can't be reassembled if DF flags/mtu mismatch.
samir-eng: quick check: `ip neigh show` on provisioning router shows neighbors flapping for macs in rack r3, likely due to switch port learning storm.
maria-ops: ops, what did the BMC image change re: secure boot? Release notes were minimal.
opsbot: release-notes v1.3.9: "BMC: Add TPM re-provision flow; tighten signature validation; minor NVRAM defaults adjusted."
tarun-plat: "tighten signature validation" probably flipped default policy for secure-boot boolean on some vendors. Combined with the mtu/trunk change, nodes could not PXE and fell back to UEFI shell.
jess-sre: mitigation options: 1) roll back BMC to v1.3.8 on affected racks, 2) adjust OOB MTU back to 1500, 3) temporarily serve signed PXE images matching new policy (longer-term). Which do we want first?
maria-ops: priority is getting nodes back into cluster. Rollback + MTU revert in parallel. Samir/Tarun — coordinate. I'll spin up capacity elsewhere for the impacted workloads.
samir-eng: ack. Starting BMC rollback plan (per runbook) for rack r3. Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/bmc-rollback. Will do canary on 3 hosts then bulk.
tarun-plat: reverting MTU on spine-l3 now. Command: `ip link set dev br-oob mtu 1500` — applying to 2 spines and leafs.
jess-sre: also enabling a temporary PXE fallback: unsigned minimal network boot that drops into a pre-seeded installer (not ideal but quick). Doing on tftp-prod-2.
maria-ops: estimated impact: ~40 nodes offline + provision backlog. I'll allocate 8 reserved GPUs in us-west1 and 4 in eu-west1 to absorb job queue. Cost hit: ~8k/day if we keep reserves for >24h. Approve?
samir-eng: approved for 24h. Prioritize canary rollback first to confirm BMC state flips secure-boot off.
opsbot: rollback started for r3-02 at 1748654400 (canary). Monitoring serial logs.
jess-sre: serial shows r3-02 back to PXE after rollback and MTU revert. `dmesg` shows secure boot flag cleared and PXE negotiation completes.
tarun-plat: spine MTU reverted at 1748654550 across both spines. ARP flapping subsided.
maria-ops: awesome. Please continue rollback in waves of 5, stop on any regression. Samir, update runbook entry with the MTU interaction note.
samir-eng: will add a note: "BMC signature validation + OOB MTU mismatch can prevent PXE boot; coordinate network changes with firmware rollouts."
jess-sre: follow-up: schedule a test harness to exercise TPM/secure boot toggles in staging before rollout. Filed ticket INFRA-4721.
maria-ops: owners: samir (rollback + runbook), tarun (network config changes), jess (provisioning fallback validation). I'll keep the temporary capacity live until queues normalize.
opsbot: rollback completed for rack r3 at 1748654630. Bulk job enqueued to re-provision nodes.
maria-ops: closing loop: rollback completed, MTU reverted, nodes coming up. Will watch until 1748657200 and then release reserved GPUs. Great work :thumbsup:
samir-eng: noted lessons learned.
jess-sre: will follow up with postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow.
tarun-plat: will add alert for simultaneous net config + firmware deploy changes.
maria-ops: thanks team.
